# AMEVA-Forge (v1.0.0)
> Browser-Native WebGPU Deep Learning Tensor & Autograd Engine with PyTorch Syntax

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/AMEVA-Forge
- Installation: `pip install ameva
# or in browser:
<script src="https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/lib/forge/ameva.js"></script>`
- Architecture: Compiles autograd computation graphs directly to WGSL WebGPU compute shaders, executing training and inference entirely on the client GPU with zero server egress.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import ameva as am

x = am.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]], device="webgpu", requires_grad=True)
y = (x ** 2).sum()
y.backward()
print("WebGPU Gradients:", x.grad)
```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
